verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a broad public REST API covering domain search, registration, DNS, renewals, lock, forwarding and transfers, plus Commerce APIs. It publishes machine-readable OpenAPI specs (Domains v1/v2/v3), PAT bearer auth with scopes, rate-limit headers, and stable error codes. Probes confirm llms.txt and markdown docs are live, which supports agent-driven use. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on evidence that API calls actually succeed end-to-end in practice.
